sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one move
sections.content: A real moving day uses everything from this unit at once: -ban/-ben for what's already inside a room, -on/-en/-ön for what's resting on a surface, and -ra/-re and -ról/-ről for the boxes moving between them.

items.spanish: A könyveket a polcra tesszük, a ruhákat a szekrénybe.
items.english: We put the books onto the shelf, the clothes into the wardrobe.

items.spanish: Leveszem a régi dobozokat az asztalról, és a padlóra teszem őket.
items.english: I take the old boxes off the table, and put them on the floor.

sections.content: This is the same kind of sentence-chaining you already used for schedules in Unit 2 and friendships in Unit 5 — new vocabulary each time, same skill of linking short sentences into a fuller picture.
